summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests GI-102 alone or with pembrolizumab before surgery in adults with recurrent or progressive IDH wildtype glioblastoma or IDH mutated grade 4 astrocytoma. GI-102 is given by IV infusion over 30 to 120 minutes on day 1 of cycle 1, and surgery is done 14 days later. Pembrolizumab IV may be added in some arms, and cycles repeat every 21 days, with GI-102 given for up to 2 years. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa GI-102 solo o con pembrolizumab antes de la cirugía en adultos con glioblastoma IDH silvestre o astrocitoma IDH mutado de grado 4, recurrente o progresivo. GI-102 se administra por infusión intravenosa durante 30 a 120 minutos el día 1 del ciclo 1, y la cirugía se realiza 14 días después. En algunos brazos se puede agregar pembrolizumab intravenoso, los ciclos se repiten cada 21 días y GI-102 se puede administrar hasta por 2 años. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Tissue-confirmed progressive or recurrent IDH wildtype grade IV glioblastoma (including gliosarcoma) or IDH mutated grade 4 astrocytoma
ECOG performance status 0, 1, or 2 and KPS 60 or higher
Willing to give blood and tissue samples for research
not_for: Pregnant or nursing, or of childbearing potential and not using contraception
Life-threatening raised intracranial pressure needing immediate surgery
Bevacizumab or chemotherapy within 30 days before registration
Hypersensitivity to pembrolizumab, IL-2, GI-102, or its excipients
Active hepatitis B and hepatitis C together, active tuberculosis, or prior pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease needing steroids
